Maria: Morning — quick handoff: I'm OOO after 11:30 UTC. SLO watch: p99 gen latency on shard-gpu-3 is higher than expected this morning. Dashboards: https://dashboards/internal/slo?shard=shard-gpu-3
AJ: Which shard exactly? Did the kv-evict tweak land on that pool last night?
Maria: shard-gpu-3. Yes — kv-evict policy changed in rollout r-20260315-23 and a small quantization tweak (v2-lite) deployed ~01:00 UTC. Suspect combined warmup + eviction thrash.
Leo: Can you paste the PromQL you used for p99 so I can run it locally?
Maria: PromQL:
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99,
  sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="infer",shard="shard-gpu-3"}[5m])) by (le)
)
```
ops-bot: Incident INC-457 created: p99 latency breach on shard-gpu-3 at 2026-03-16T09:12Z — paging #oncall.sre
Tara: I'm oncall, taking INC-457. Any canaries touching that shard in the past 24h?
Maria: Canary yesterday 01:00 UTC (v2-lite quant) + kv-evict change. Rollout id r-20260315-23. I'll attach the rollout diff to the ticket.
Tara: Pulling logs now. If cache-miss correlates with spikes we can bump warmup TTL to 10m for that shard; otherwise we'll revert quant tweak to v1.
Leo: FYI I merged an alert debounce change (#3127) earlier. No expected metric impact but calling it out.
AJ: Filing a follow-up: IS-89 automated post-deploy smoke for shard-gpu-3 so future canaries surface warmup regressions.
Tara: Action plan: 1) check kv eviction rate and cache-miss metric 2) if miss rate > baseline, bump warmup TTL or rollback eviction tweak 3) if error budget drops >0.02% escalate to infra. I'll update INC-457 with findings.
Maria: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evict-handling. Logs: https://dashboards/internal/logs?query=shard-gpu-3
Tara: I'll post a summary here in 30m. If no spikes by 12:00 UTC I'll close INC-457 and file an optimize-team ticket for warmup profiling.
Maria: :thumbsup:
